blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos. We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers operational performance, video quality, text-video alignment, and reference fidelity, while subjective evaluation uses an MLLM judge to evaluate instruction following and holistic video quality. Extensive evaluation of 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine families reveals that even leading models face challenges in reliably generating high-quality complete videos aligned with textual and visual requirements, with performance generally declining as construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity increases. We anticipate that Code2Video-Compass will advance reliable, coherent, and controllable code-based video generation and inspire broader progress in programmatic visual creation.
blocks.zh: 与直接视频生成相比,基于代码的视频生成提供了精细的控制,目标编辑,组件再利用. 这种方法要求多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)将视觉和时间要求转化为可执行的程序,产生完整的视频. 然而,现有的基于代码的基准主要针对专门的任务,使得不同创意类别和输入模式的完整视频创建没有得到充分的评价. 我们引入了Code2Video-Compass,这是跨文本到视频(T2V),图像到视频(I2V)和视频到视频(V2V)设置的基于代码视频生成的通用基准. Code2Video-Compass包含2,104项任务,包括10个类别,24个子类型,以及三个复杂维度,包括构造,动态动画,以及状态依赖. 它将从文字指令和视觉参考中解析的任务与相应的T2V,I2V,以及从完整的专业和用户创建的视频中衍生出来的V2V任务结合起来. 我们提出一个双重评价框架,将12个客观指标和5个主观指标结合起来。 客观评价涵盖业务性能,视频质量,文本-视频对齐,以及参考忠诚度,主观评价则使用MLLM法官来评价遵循和整体视频质量的指令. 对最近来自9个家庭的15个专有和开放量的MLLMs的广泛评价表明,即使是主要模型在可靠地生成符合文字和视觉要求的高质量完整视频方面都面临挑战,随着构造、动态动画和状态依赖性复杂性的提高,性能普遍下降。 我们预计,Code2Video-Compass将推进可靠、连贯和可控制的基于代码的视频生成,并激励在方案视觉创建方面取得更广泛的进展。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 41 , 3 , 18 , 44 , 38 ] are making it increasingly feasible to create complete videos through executable code, a task requiring world knowledge, spatial reasoning, creative judgment, and complex programming.
Compared with direct video generation, code-based approaches explicitly represent visual structures and animation parameters, enabling fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse [ 33 , 12 , 46 ] .
Generating complete videos that follow textual instructions requires models to plan coherent narratives and visuals, reliably generate lengthy code across interdependent files, and coordinate animations and evolving states across scenes and timelines.
Moreover, visual references introduce additional challenges, requiring models to reconstruct the referenced appearance or motion and integrate it into the complete video [ 63 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh:
多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)[41,3,18,44,38]的近期进步使得通过可执行代码制作完整的视频变得日益可行,这项任务需要世界知识,空间推理,创造性判断,以及复杂的编程.
与直接视频生成相比,基于代码的方法明确代表视觉结构和动画参数,能够进行精细的控制,有目标的编辑,以及组件的再利用[33,12,46].
生成遵循文字指令的完整视频需要模型来规划连贯的叙事和视觉,可靠地在相互依存的文件中生成冗长的代码,协调动画和跨越场景和时间段的演化状态.
此外,视觉参考还带来了更多的挑战,要求模型重建被引用的外观或运动,并将其纳入完整的视频[63,29].

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks for direct video generation, including VBench [ 22 ] , EvalCrafter [ 32 ] , and T2V-CompBench [ 51 ] , evaluate visual quality, semantic alignment, and compositional requirements, while LongAV-Compass [ 30 ] extends evaluation to longer sequences and multiple input conditions. Code-based tasks target specialized applications or representations, including Manim educational videos [ 13 ] , data narratives [ 35 ] , SVG animations [ 53 ] , and web animation reconstruction [ 24 ] . Similarly, HeyGen’s Code2Video Benchmark [ 62 ] focuses on short motion graphics clips representing individual beats of product launch videos.
Nevertheless, as shown in Tab. 1 , existing code-based benchmarks remain limited in task coverage and input modalities, and lack comprehensive evaluation combining objective and subjective metrics.
blocks.zh:
现有的直接视频生成基准,包括V Bench [22],EvalCrafter [32],以及T2V-Comp Bench [51],评价视觉质量,语义对齐,以及组成要求,而LongAV-Compass [30]则将评价扩展到较长的序列和多个输入条件. 基于代码的任务针对专业应用或表现,包括马尼姆教育视频[13],数据叙事[35],SVG动画[53],以及网络动画重建[24]. 同样,HeyGen的Code2Video基准[62]侧重于代表个人节拍产品发布视频的短动图形片段.
然而,如表1所示,现有基于守则的基准在任务范围和投入模式方面仍然有限,而且缺乏将客观和主观衡量标准结合起来的全面评价。

blocks.en:
To address these gaps, we introduce Code2Video-Compass (Fig. ), a general-purpose benchmark for code-based text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) generation, where models create complete videos following textual instructions and, when provided, reconstruct and integrate visual references at appropriate temporal positions.
Guided by a taxonomy of motion-design practices, we combine independently constructed tasks based on curated textual instructions and visual references with tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos.
This yields 2,104 tasks across 10 categories and 24 subtypes, each annotated along three complexity dimensions: construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency.
We further propose a comprehensive dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics.
Objective evaluation measures execution success, token consumption, technical and aesthetic quality, motion smoothness, text–video alignment, and reference fidelity.
Subjective evaluation employs an MLLM-as-a-judge protocol to evaluate fine-grained instruction following through explicit checklists and evaluate holistic creative quality across content coherence, visual design, motion quality, and viewer engagement.
blocks.zh:
为了填补这些空白,我们引入了Code2Video-Compass(图),这是基于代码的文本对视频(T2V),图像对视频(I2V)和视频对视频(V2V)生成的通用基准,模型根据文本指令创建完整的视频,并在提供时,在适当的时间位置上重建和整合视觉参考.
在运动设计实践的分类学指引下,我们根据整理过的文字说明和视觉参考,将独立构建的任务与完整专业和用户制作的视频衍生的任务结合起来.
这产生了涉及10个类别和24个子类型的2 104项任务,每个子类型都按三个复杂维度附加说明:构造、动态动画和状态依赖。
我们进一步提出一个综合的双重评价框架,将12个客观指标和5个主观指标结合起来。
客观评价衡量执行成功、象征性消费、技术和美学质量、运动顺畅性、文本-视频对齐和参考忠诚。
主观评价采用MLLM-as-a-judge协议,通过明确的核对表评价精细指示,并评价内容一致性、外观设计、运动质量和观众参与的综合创造性质量。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation. We formulate unified T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks that require MLLMs to generate executable code for video generation. • Taxonomy-Driven Benchmark Dataset. We curate 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories and 24 subtypes, annotated along three complexity dimensions, each with three levels. • Comprehensive Dual-Level Evaluation Framework. We integrate 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics to evaluate code-based video generation capabilities. • Extensive MLLM Benchmarking and Insights. We evaluate 15 proprietary and open-weight MLLMs, revealing that video quality and execution reliability do not always align, with performance declining as complexity increases.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的主要贡献如下: • 通用密码视频生成。 我们制定统一的T2V,I2V,和V2V任务,这些任务要求MLLMs生成视频生成的可执行代码. • 分类学-驱动基准数据集。 我们负责2 104项任务,涉及10个类别和24个子类型,并按三个复杂层面附加说明,每个层面有三个级别。 • 综合双重评价框架。 我们整合了12个客观度量衡和5个主观度量衡来评价基于代码的视频生成能力. • 广泛制定《反洗钱法》基准和见解。 我们评价了15个专有和开放重量的MLLM,揭示视频质量和执行可靠性并不总是一致,随着复杂性的增加,性能下降。

blocks.en: General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation. We formulate unified T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks that require MLLMs to generate executable code for video generation.
blocks.zh: 通用密码视频生成. 我们制定统一的T2V,I2V,和V2V任务,这些任务要求MLLMs生成视频生成的可执行代码.

blocks.en: Taxonomy-Driven Benchmark Dataset. We curate 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories and 24 subtypes, annotated along three complexity dimensions, each with three levels.
blocks.zh: 分类学-驱动基准数据集. 我们负责2 104项任务,涉及10个类别和24个子类型,并按三个复杂层面附加说明,每个层面有三个级别。

blocks.en: Comprehensive Dual-Level Evaluation Framework. We integrate 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics to evaluate code-based video generation capabilities.
blocks.zh: 全面的双重评价框架。 我们整合了12个客观度量衡和5个主观度量衡来评价基于代码的视频生成能力.

blocks.en: Extensive MLLM Benchmarking and Insights. We evaluate 15 proprietary and open-weight MLLMs, revealing that video quality and execution reliability do not always align, with performance declining as complexity increases.
blocks.zh: 广泛的 MLLM 基准与洞察. 我们评价了15个专有和开放重量的MLLM,揭示视频质量和执行可靠性并不总是一致,随着复杂性的增加,性能下降。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Direct Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 直接视频生成

blocks.en:
Benchmarks for direct video generation have established diverse evaluation tasks and frameworks for assessing model capabilities. VBench [ 22 ] and EvalCrafter [ 32 ] evaluate perceptual quality, while T2V-CompBench [ 51 ] and TC-Bench [ 16 ] examine compositional and temporal constraints. VBench++ [ 23 ] and KeyFrame-Compass [ 52 ] extend evaluation to image conditioning and keyframe adherence. StoryBench [ 9 ] , MSVBench [ 48 ] , and LongAV-Compass [ 30 ] further address narrative progression and long-range consistency, with the latter covering text, image, and video conditioning. T2AV-Compass [ 10 ] combines objective and subjective evaluation.
However, code-based video generation requires evaluating operational performance and the technical, semantic, and creative quality of complete videos.
blocks.zh:
直接制作视频的基准为评估模型能力确定了不同的评价任务和框架。 V Bench [22] 和 EvalCrafter [32] 评估知觉质量,而T2V-Comp Bench [51]和TC-Bench [16] 则审查组成和时间限制. V Bench++ [23] 和 KeyFrame-Compass [52] 将评价扩展到图像配置和密钥框的坚持性. Story Bench [9],MSV Bench [48],和LongAV-Compass [30] 进一步论述叙事进展和远程一致性,后者涵盖文本,图像,视频配置. T2AV-Compass [10] 结合了客观和主观的评价.
然而,基于代码的视频生成需要评价操作性能以及完整视频的技术,语义和创造性质量.

blocks.en: 2.2 Code-Based Video and Animation Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于密码的视频和动画制作

blocks.en: Prior work has explored code-based video and animation generation across specialized applications. Code2Video [ 13 ] introduces a Manim-based agent framework and the MMMC benchmark for educational videos, while DataReel [ 35 ] supports animated data storytelling. LogoMotion [ 31 ] generates editable logo animations, and MG-Gen [ 49 ] produces layered HTML animations from images. InternSVG [ 53 ] and LottieGPT [ 12 ] explore structured vector animations.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作探索了跨专业应用的基于代码的视频和动画生成. Code2Video [13]引入了基于Manim的代理框架和教育视频的MMMC基准,而DataReel [35]支持动画数据故事描述. LogoMotion [31] 生成可编辑的标志动画,MG-Gen [49] 从图像中生成分层的HTML动画. InternSVG [53]和LottieGPT [12] 探索结构化矢量动画.

blocks.en: Evaluation of code-based generation has advanced within specific tasks. MMMC evaluates aesthetics, knowledge transfer, and efficiency, while Animation2Code [ 24 ] evaluates execution, appearance, and motion fidelity. MoVer [ 34 ] verifies motion constraints, and HeyGen’s Code2Video Benchmark [ 62 ] employs subjective evaluation of short promotional motion graphics. However, comprehensive evaluation of complete code-generated videos across diverse creative categories and input conditions remains limited.
blocks.zh: 对基于代码的生成的评价在具体任务范围内取得了进展。 MMMC评价美学,知识转让,以及效率,而动画2Code[24]则评价执行,外表,运动忠贞. MoVer [34] 验证运动限制,HeyGen的代码2Video基准 [62] 采用了对短促运动图形的主观评价. 然而,对不同创意类别和输入条件的完整代码制作的视频的全面评价仍然有限。

blocks.en: Tab. 1 summarizes task sources, generation paradigms, input settings, scale, and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 标签1概述了任务来源、生成范式、输入设置、规模和评价。

blocks.en: 3 Code2Video-Compass
blocks.zh: 3 代码2 视频编码

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 制定任务

blocks.en: Code2Video-Compass evaluates general-purpose code-based video generation, where MLLMs translate textual instructions and optional visual references into executable projects. The rendering stack supports HTML/CSS, SVG, Canvas, and Three.js, with Remotion [ 46 ] producing the videos. Generated videos must exhibit coherent progression across events or visual states, with reference content reconstructed through code rather than directly embedded or replayed. We consider three input settings:
blocks.zh: Code2Video-Compass评价通用代码视频生成,其中MLLMs将文本指令和可选的视觉引用翻译为可执行项目. 渲染堆栈支持HTML/CSS,SVG,Canvas,和Tree.js,由Remotion[46]制作视频. 生成的视频必须显示跨事件或视觉状态的连贯进展,参考内容通过代码重建,而不是直接嵌入或重播. 我们考虑三种投入设置:

blocks.en:
Text-to-Video (T2V). Models interpret a self-contained instruction and generate code
to realize the specified visual content and temporal progression.
blocks.zh:
文本对视频(T2V). 模型解释自成一体的指令并生成代码
实现指定的视觉内容和时间进展。

blocks.en: Image-to-Video (I2V). Models interpret the instruction and reference keyframe, understand its visual content, determine where it should appear in the complete video, and generate code to reconstruct and integrate its visual state.
blocks.zh: 图像对视频(I2V). 模型解释指令和参考键框,理解其视觉内容,确定它应该出现在完整的视频中的位置,并生成代码来重建和整合其视觉状态.

blocks.en: Video-to-Video (V2V). Models interpret the instruction and reference clip, determine its placement in the complete video, and generate code to reconstruct and integrate its appearance, motion, and event sequence.
blocks.zh: 视频对视频(V2V). 模型解释指令和参考片段,决定其在完整视频中的位置,并生成代码来重建和整合其外观,运动,和事件序列.

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Categories and Complexity
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据类别和复杂度

blocks.en: Construction Complexity measures visual construction demands: standard primitives and component compositions (Level 1), custom geometry and detailed structures (Level 2), and procedural or simulation systems (Level 3).
blocks.zh: 构造复杂度测量视觉构造需求:标准原始和组件组成(一级),自定义几何和详细结构(二级),程序或模拟系统(三级).

blocks.en: Dynamic Animation Complexity measures temporal organization: staged sequences (Level 1), coordinated changes across elements and scenes (Level 2), and complex concurrent motion or transformations (Level 3).
blocks.zh: 动态动画 复杂度测量时间组织:阶段序列(一级),元素和场景间协调变化(二级),以及复杂的同时运动或转变(三级).

blocks.en: State-Dependency Complexity measures the temporal span over which objects, data, and states must remain consistent: adjacent stages (Level 1), intervening stages (Level 2), and long-range dependencies across multiple changes (Level 3).
blocks.zh: 国家依赖性复杂度衡量对象、数据和状态必须保持一致的时间跨度:相邻阶段(一级)、干预阶段(二级)和跨越多个变化的远距离依赖性(三级)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据构建

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Data construction pipeline. (A) Independent tasks are developed from curated text seeds, reference images, and video clips. (B) Paired T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks are derived from shared complete source videos. (C) Both task sets undergo prompt construction, QA checklist development, and annotation of subjects, temporal events, motion types, and three complexity dimensions, yielding 2,104 tasks.
blocks.zh: 图2:数据建设管道。 (A) 独立的任务由编译的文字种子、参考图像和录像片段制定。 (B)Paired T2V,I2V,和V2V任务源于共享完整的源视频. (C) 两组任务都经过了迅速构建,QA清单的制定,以及主题的注释,时间事件,运动类型,以及三个复杂维度,共产生2,104项任务.

blocks.en:
We construct 2,104 tasks through two complementary strategies, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . The Independent Task Set broadens creative coverage using text seeds and visual references, while the Paired Task Set grounds tasks in real-world creative practice by deriving them from complete professional and user-created videos.
Three co-authors conduct manual verification and quality review throughout the data construction process.
blocks.zh:
如图所示,我们通过两个相辅相成的战略,确定了2 104项任务。 2. 《独立任务集》利用文字种子和视觉参考扩大了创造性的覆盖范围,而《Paired任务集》则通过从完整的专业和用户制作的视频中提取这些内容,在现实世界的创造性实践中设定了基础任务。
三位合著者在整个数据构建过程中进行人工核查和质量审查.

blocks.en: Independent Task Set. For T2V, we source prompts from VidProM [ 54 ] and video descriptions from Shot2Story [ 19 ] . After source-specific cleaning, deterministic sampling yields 54,443 candidates, which we embed using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 [ 47 ] . With GPT-6.1 Sol [ 40 ] assistance and human review, taxonomy-guided curation narrows the pool to 720 candidates, from which we select 145 diverse task seeds.
blocks.zh: 独立任务集(Independent Task Set),对于T2V,我们从VidProM[54]和Shot2 Story[19]的视频描述中源出提示. 在进行特定来源的清洗后,确定性取样结果为54,443名候选人,我们使用全MiniLM-L6-v2[47]进行嵌入。在GPT-6.1 Sol [40] 帮助和人类审查下,分类学指导法将库缩小到720名候选人,我们从中选择了145个不同的任务种子。

blocks.en: For I2V, we curate reference images from LICA [ 20 ] , SciDraw-6K [ 11 ] , SynthChartNet [ 39 ] , and PD12M [ 36 ] . For V2V, we collect animation videos from YouTube [ 61 ] . For both settings, we curate 15 candidates per subtype and select five through content verification and manual quality review, yielding 120 references from 360 candidates in each setting. We crop a continuous 2–10 s key segment from each selected video to form the V2V reference clip. These seeds and references guide complete-video task construction.
blocks.zh: 对于I2V,我们整理来自LICA [20],SciDraw-6K [11],SynthChartNet [39],和PD12M [36]的参考图像. 对于V2V,我们从YouTube收集动画视频[61]. 对于这两种情况,我们每类15名候选人接受调查,通过内容核查和人工质量审查挑选5名候选人,每类360名候选人提供120次推荐。 我们从每个选定的视频中绘制一个连续的 2 - 10 键段,形成 V2V 参考片段 。 这些种子和参考文献指导了完整的视频任务构建.

blocks.en: Paired Task Set. To cover professional and user-created videos across platforms, we collect 197 animation records from YouTube [ 61 ] and 2,473 candidate URLs from Bilibili [ 8 ] , REDnote [ 45 ] , and X [ 58 ] . We screen candidates for video completeness and suitability for code-based generation with assistance from Gemini 3.8 Flash [ 18 ] , retaining 979 videos. We remove exact duplicates using normalized URLs and SHA-256 hashes, and identify near-duplicates across all video sources using SSCD [ 43 ] frame embeddings indexed with FAISS [ 15 ] . Temporal matching distinguishes reposted works from videos with similar visual styles. After deduplication, we score the remaining 915 videos for narrative progression, content, visual design, and motion quality using Gemini 3.8 Flash. Human review retains 573 complete videos, from which we select representative keyframes and crop continuous 2–10 s reference clips with Gemini 3.8 Flash assistance and human verification. Each video yields aligned T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks with shared creative goals and event progression, totaling 1,719 tasks.
blocks.zh: Paired 任务集 。 为了覆盖跨平台的专业和用户制作的视频,我们从YouTube[61]收集了197个动画记录,从bilibili[8],REDnot[45],和X[58]收集了2,473个候选URL. 在双子座3.8 Flash 的协助下,我们筛选候选人的视频完整性和是否适合代码生成,保留979个视频。 我们使用正常的URL和SHA-256散列物去除确切的复制品,并用SSCD[43]帧嵌入与FAISS[15]索引的所有视频源识别近复制品. Temperal配对区分了重播作品与具有类似视觉风格的视频. 分解后,我们用双子座3.8 Flash对剩下的915个视频进行叙事进度,内容,视觉设计和运动质量的评分. 人类评论保留了573个完整的视频,我们从中选择具有代表性的关键框架和连续的2至10个参考片段,双子座3.8 Flash协助和人类验证. 每一段视频都对齐了T2V,I2V和V2V任务与共同的创意目标和事件进展,共1,719项任务.

blocks.en:
Prompt Construction and Annotation. We develop detailed, self-contained instructions for both task sets with assistance from Gemini 3.8 Flash and human review. Independent instructions specify a new complete video based on each text seed or visual reference. For each paired source, we jointly develop T2V, I2V, and V2V instructions with shared core content requirements and event progression. Instructions specify visual elements, spatial relationships, exact text and data, motion, event sequences, and cross-stage dependencies, including reference content and surrounding events where applicable. We annotate subjects, temporal events, motion types, and three complexity dimensions, and construct fine-grained QA checklists for instruction following, as described in Sec. 3.5.2 .
We iteratively review and refine these checklists with assistance from GPT-6.1 Sol.
blocks.zh:
即时建设与注释. 在双子座3.8 Flash和人类审查的协助下,我们为这两项任务制定了详细、自成一体的指示。 独立指令根据每个文本种子或视觉参考指定一个新的完整视频. 对于每个配对源,我们共同开发T2V,I2V,和V2V指令,具有共享的核心内容要求和事件进展. 指令规定了视觉要素,空间关系,准确的文字和数据,运动,事件序列,以及跨阶段的依赖性,包括参考内容和适用的周围事件. 如第3.5.2节所述,我们对主题、时间事件、运动类型和三个复杂维度进行注释,并构建精细的质量保证清单,供指导。
在GPT-6.1 Sol的协助下,我们反复审查和完善这些核对表。

blocks.zh: 3.4 数据集统计

blocks.en: The benchmark combines 1,719 paired tasks from 573 source videos with 385 independent tasks, totaling 2,104 tasks across T2V (718), I2V (693), and V2V (693). For coverage analysis, we count each paired source once, resulting in 958 records comprising 573 paired sources and 385 independent tasks. Figures 3 and 4 characterize coverage across creative categories, subjects, motion types, video duration, prompt length, and the three complexity dimensions, demonstrating the breadth and diversity of the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 该基准将573个源视频的1 719个配对任务与385个独立任务合并,共2 104个任务跨越T2V(718),I2V(693)和V2V(693). 就覆盖面分析而言,我们计算了每个配对源一次,结果有958个记录,包括573个配对源和385个独立任务. 图3和图4显示各创意类别、主题、运动类型、视频持续时间、即时长度和三个复杂层面的覆盖面,显示了基准的广度和多样性。

blocks.en: 3.5 Dual-Level Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 3.5 双重评价框架

blocks.en: We introduce a dual-level evaluation framework comprising 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers execution reliability, efficiency, video quality, text–video alignment, and reference fidelity. We employ Gemini 3.8 Flash [ 18 ] to evaluate instruction following and rate four dimensions of holistic video quality.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了由12个客观衡量尺度和5个主观衡量尺度组成的双重评价框架。 目标评价涵盖执行的可靠性、效率、视频质量、文本-视频对齐和参考忠诚。 我们使用双子座 3.8 Flash [18] 来评价按照和评分四个维度的整体视频质量.

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Objective Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 目标评价

blocks.en: Operational Performance . Practical video creation requires reliable execution and efficient generation. Execution success measures whether the code produces a usable video, while token consumption measures generation effort.
blocks.zh: 业务绩效. 实用的视频创作需要可靠的执行和高效的生成. 执行成功度量代码是否产生可用视频,而象征性消费度量生成努力.

blocks.en: Execution Success (ES). Usable video projects must execute and render successfully. We report the fraction of sampled tasks producing complete, playable videos without errors under the shared backend and resource limits. Failed outputs receive zero on all non operational metrics to prevent inflated averages from excluding difficult tasks.
blocks.zh: 执行成功(ES). 可使用的视频项目必须成功执行和渲染。 我们报告在共享后端和资源限制下制作完整、可播放的视频的抽样任务的一小部分。 失败的产出在所有非业务指标上得到零,以防止过高的平均数排除困难的任务。

blocks.en: Token Consumption (TC). We measure generation efficiency using mean API-reported output tokens per attempted task, consistent with token-based model comparisons such as Artificial Analysis [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 托肯消费(TC). 我们使用每个尝试任务的平均API报告输出符来测量生成效率,与基于符号的模型比较一致,如人工分析[6].

blocks.en: Video Quality . Rendered videos need clear images, appealing visual presentation, and temporally consistent motion. The objective metrics capture these complementary properties through technical quality, aesthetic quality, and motion smoothness.
blocks.zh: 视频质量. 制作的视频需要清晰的图像,吸引人的视觉展示,以及时间上一致的运动. 客观的衡量标准通过技术质量、美学质量和运动光滑来捕捉这些互补特性。

blocks.en: Technical Quality (TQ). Technical degradation, including blur, noise, and compression artifacts, affects the clarity of rendered content. The technical branch of DOVER++ [ 57 ] provides a score for this aspect of video quality.
blocks.zh: 技术质量(TQ). 技术退化,包括模糊、噪音和压缩文物,影响到所制作内容的清晰度。 DOVER++[57]的技术分支为视频质量的这一方面提供了分数.

blocks.en: Aesthetic Quality (AQ). The visual appeal of composition, color, and style contributes to effective presentation. Averaging frame-level scores from Aesthetic Predictor V2.5 [ 1 ] gives a video-level estimate of aesthetic quality.
blocks.zh: 审美质量 (AQ). 组成、颜色和风格的视觉吸引力有助于有效展示。 Average fram-level 得分来自审美Predictor V2.5 [1]给出了审美质量的视频级估计.

blocks.en: Motion Smoothness (MS). Smooth motion should be temporally predictable from neighboring frames. We resample videos to 24 FPS and use AMT [ 28 ] to predict each intermediate frame from its two neighbors. The score is one minus the mean RGB absolute error normalized by 255, excluding comparisons across hard cuts.
blocks.zh: 运动平滑 (MS). 平滑运动应该从相邻的框架上在时间上可以预测. 我们把视频重新做成24个FPS,并使用AMT[28]从两个邻居那里预测每个中间帧. 得分为1减去255正常化的RGB平均绝对误差,不包括硬截面的比较.

blocks.en: Text–Video Alignment . Instructions describe individual events and the overall progression of a complete video. Local TVAlign and Global TVAlign evaluate semantic correspondence at these two scales across T2V, I2V, and V2V.
blocks.zh: 文本 - 视频对齐 。 指令描述了个别事件和完整视频的整体进展。 本地TVAlign和GlobalTVAlign以这两个尺度评价跨T2V,I2V,V2V的语义通信.

blocks.en: Local TVAlign (L-TVA). Local TVAlign measures local semantic correspondence between eight-frame sliding video windows and text chunks derived from global and event-level descriptions. We compute window-level alignment scores using ViCLIP-L [ 55 ] and aggregate them across the video.
blocks.zh: 当地TVAlign (L-TVA). 本地 TVAlign 测量八帧滑动视频窗口和从全局和事件级别描述衍生出来的文本块之间的本地语义对应. 我们使用 ViCLIP-L [55] 计算出窗口级的对齐分数,并将其汇总到整个视频中.

blocks.en: Global TVAlign (G-TVA). Global TVAlign measures semantic alignment between the complete video and the instruction as a whole, complementing local alignment and reference-fidelity metrics. We use Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B [ 27 ] to encode the instruction and frames spanning the video, then compute their embedding cosine similarity.
blocks.zh: 全球电视同步(G-TVA). Global TVAlign度量完整视频和整个指令之间的语义校正,补充了本地的校正和参考-诚实度量. 我们使用Qune3-VL-Embedding-8B [27] 编码横跨视频的指令和帧,然后计算其嵌入式余弦相似性.

blocks.en: I2V Reference Fidelity . Reference keyframes may appear at any stage, so we search the full generated video for the closest matching frame. Perceptual and structural fidelity measure visual resemblance and image structure.
blocks.zh: 一、二五类 参考 Fidelity. 引用键框可能出现在任何阶段,因此我们搜索全部生成的视频,以获取最接近的匹配帧. 观念和结构上的忠贞度量视觉的相似性和图像结构.

blocks.en: Perceptual Fidelity (PF). Recognizable subjects and visual elements are central to reconstructing the reference image. We use DINOv3 [ 50 ] features to locate the closest matching frame and measure perceptual resemblance.
blocks.zh: 感知菲德尔(PF). 可识别主体和视觉元素是重建参考图像的核心. 我们使用DINOv3[50]特性来定位最接近的匹配框架并测量知觉相似性.

blocks.en: Structural Fidelity (SF). Faithful reconstruction also requires preserving the reference’s local image structure. SSIM [ 56 ] measures luminance, contrast, and structural similarity at the same matching frame.
blocks.zh: 结构菲德尔(SF). 忠实的重建也要求保留参考的当地图像结构. SSIM [56] 在同一匹配框架测量亮度,对比度和结构相似度.

blocks.en: V2V Reference Fidelity . The reference clip must be reconstructed within a complete video, so we first locate its corresponding interval in the output. Sequence alignment, appearance fidelity, and motion fidelity measure visual sequence correspondence, appearance similarity, and motion consistency within this interval.
blocks.zh: 五维 参考 Fidelity. 参考片段必须在完整的视频中重建,所以我们首先在输出中找到相应的间隔. 序列对齐,外观忠贞,运动忠贞度度量视觉序列的对应,外观相似,运动一致性在此间隔内.

blocks.en: Sequence Alignment (SA). To measure whether the reference’s visual progression is preserved despite timing differences, we locate the corresponding interval using subsequence dynamic time warping (DTW) on DINOv3 [ 50 ] frame embeddings. The score is the mean cosine similarity along the matched path.
blocks.zh: 序列对齐(SA). 为了衡量参考文献的视觉进展是否保留,尽管时间有差异,我们使用DINov3 [50]帧嵌入物上的子序列动态时间扭曲(DTW)来定位相应的间隔. 得分是对应路径上的平均余弦相似度.

blocks.en: Appearance Fidelity (AF). The reconstructed interval should preserve the reference’s subjects, colors, and shapes. Within the localized interval, we perform constrained DTW using DreamSim [ 17 ] cosine distances and define AF as one minus the path-averaged distance.
blocks.zh: 外观Fidelity (AF). 重建的间隔应保留参考对象、颜色和形状。 在本地化间隔内,我们使用DreamSim [17] 余弦距离来进行受限DTW,并将AF定义为1减去路径平均距离.

blocks.en: Motion Fidelity (MF). Similar visual appearance and temporal sequences do not necessarily imply similar motion patterns. We use CoTracker3 [ 26 ] to extract point trajectories from the reference clip and the localized generated interval and compare their displacement directions and magnitudes after spatial and temporal normalization. We aggregate trajectory similarities through bidirectional best matching.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). Motion Fidelity (MF). 类似的视觉外观和时间序列并不一定意味着类似的运动模式. 我们利用CoTracker 3[26]从参考片段和局部生成的间隔中提取点轨迹,并在空间和时间正常化后比较其迁移方向和规模。 我们通过双向最佳匹配来汇总轨迹相似性.

blocks.en: 3.5.2 Subjective Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 主观评价

blocks.en: Instruction Following (IF) . We derive verifiable QA checklists from each instruction and employ Gemini 3.8 Flash [ 18 ] to check whether the generated video satisfies each requirement. Each checklist contains up to 16 questions, including up to 14 generic questions across six dimensions and two task-specific questions. The six dimensions are (1) Content , covering exact text and information, (2) Attribute , covering appearance and quantity, (3) Composition , covering layout, framing, and color, (4) Relations , covering spatial and logical connections, (5) Dynamics , covering motion, interaction, transformation, viewport motion, and temporal relations, and (6) Aesthetics , covering style. The two task-specific questions cover full-video requirements or reference integration. IF reports the fraction of questions passed.
blocks.zh: 遵循指示(IF). 我们从每个指令中得出可核查的质量保证核对表,并使用双子座3.8 Flash[18]检查生成的视频是否符合每个要求. 每个清单包含最多16个问题,包括涉及六个层面的最多14个一般性问题和两个具体任务的问题。 六个维度是 (1)内容,涵盖准确的文字和信息; (2)属性,涵盖外观和数量; (3)构成,涵盖布局,框架,和颜色; (4)关系,涵盖空间和逻辑联系; (5)动态,涵盖运动,互动,转化,观光运动,以及时间关系; (6)美学,涵盖风格. 这两个具体任务的问题涉及全视频要求或参考资料整合。 如果报告通过的问题的一小部分。

blocks.en: Holistic Video Quality . Creating an effective complete video requires coherent content, purposeful design, expressive motion, and sustained viewer interest. We rate these four aspects using five-point Likert scales.
blocks.zh: 综合视频质量. 制作一个有效的完整视频需要一致的内容,有目的的设计,表现动作,以及持续的观众兴趣. 我们用五点的Irikrt比例来评定这四个方面。

blocks.en: Content Coherence (CC). Content coherence is rated based on progression, relationships among stages, state continuity, and consistency of text, data, charts, and interfaces.
blocks.zh: 内容一致性。 内容一致性是根据进度、各阶段之间的关系、状态连续性以及文本、数据、图表和界面的一致性来评定的。

blocks.en: Visual Design (VD). Visual design is rated based on composition, typography, readability, color, visual hierarchy, and purposeful detail within the intended style.
blocks.zh: 视觉设计 (VD). 视觉设计根据成份,打字,可读性,颜色,视觉等级,以及预定风格内的有目的细节来评分.

blocks.en: Motion Quality (MQ). Motion quality is rated based on easing, pacing, continuity, transitions, coordinated elements, temporal hierarchy, and behavioral variety, capturing both smoothness and expressive choreography.
blocks.zh: 运动质量 (MQ). 运动质量根据放松,节奏,连续性,过渡,协调元素,时序分级,行为多样性进行评分,既捕捉平滑性,又捕捉表现性舞蹈.

blocks.en: Viewer Engagement (VE). Viewer engagement is rated by how well emphasis, pacing, and presentation sustain interest in a way that suits the video’s intended use.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-09-26). Viewers Effairs (VE). 观众参与的评分是强调、节奏和展示如何以适合视频预期用途的方式维持兴趣。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine model families, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna [ 41 , 40 , 42 ] , Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5 [ 3 , 4 , 2 ] , Gemini 3.8 Flash [ 18 ] , Qwen3.8-Max, Qwen3.8-Flash, Qwen3.8-27B [ 44 ] , Kimi K3 [ 38 ] , GLM-5.3-Flash [ 64 ] , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [ 14 ] , MiniMax M3 [ 37 ] , and MiMo-V2.6-Pro [ 59 ] .
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评价了最近来自9个模范家庭的15个专有和开放重量的MLLM, 包括GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna [41, 40, 42], Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5 [3, 4, 2], 双子座3.8 Flash [18], Quen3.8-Max, Quen3.8-Flash, Quen3.8-27B [44], Kimi K3 [38], GLM-5.3-Flash [64], DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [14], MiniMax M3 [37],和MiMo-V2.6-Pro [59].

blocks.en:
Evaluation Protocol. For task selection, we sample approximately half of the records from each of our two task construction strategies, yielding a fixed subset of 1,054 tasks (360 T2V, 347 I2V, and 347 V2V) for all models.
The subset shows no significant differences from unsampled records in the distributions of the three complexity dimensions defined in Sec. 3.2 (Pearson’s χ 2 \chi^{2} tests, p Holm > 0.05 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}>0.05 , V < 0.02 V<0.02 ) or prompt lengths (Welch’s t t -tests, p Holm > 0.05 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}>0.05 , | g | < 0.05 |g|<0.05 ).
For model inference, each model generates code from task instructions and applicable visual references in a single API call, without execution feedback or repair.
We use each provider’s default reasoning settings. Output token totals include reasoning tokens reported by the API.
For V2V Task, GPT and Claude receive 4-FPS frame sequences, while other models receive native videos with API sampling set to 4 FPS.
blocks.zh:
评价协议。 为了选择任务,我们从我们两个任务构建战略中分别抽取了大约一半的记录,得出一个固定子集,即所有模型的1 054项任务(360 T2V、347 I2V和347 V2V)。
该子集显示在Sec.3.2(皮尔逊的XQ 2\chi^{2}测试,p Holm > 0.05 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}>0.05,V < 0.02 V < 0.02)或即时长度定义的三个复杂维度的分布中,没有显著的区别. (Welch's t - t tests, p Holm > 0.05 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}>0.05, | g| < 0.05 g|<0.05).
对于模型推论,每个模型在单个API呼叫中从任务指令和适用的视觉参考生成代码,没有执行反馈或修复.
我们使用每个提供者的默认推理设置 。 输出令牌总数包括API报告的推理令牌.
用于 V2V Task,GPT和Claude接收4-FPS帧序列,而其他模型接收的原生视频则使用API采样集为4FPS.

blocks.en:
Overall Performance. Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the best average rank across all three settings, with 1.60 on T2V, 1.08 on I2V, and 1.15 on V2V, followed by Claude Sonnet 5.5 in each setting.
Proprietary models occupy the top three positions in every setting.
Among open-weight models, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash leads T2V, while MiMo-V2.6-Pro leads I2V and V2V.
Execution success varies considerably across models, ranging from 0.52 to 0.94 on T2V, 0.59 to 0.96 on I2V, and 0.69 to 0.97 on V2V.
blocks.zh:
总体业绩。 Claude Opus 5.5在所有三种设置中都取得了最佳平均排名,其中T2V为1.60级,I2V为1.08级,V2V为1.15级,其次是Claude Sonnet 5.5级.
专有模式在每个设置中占据前三名.
在开放量级模型中,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash领先T2V,而MiMo-V2.6-Pro领先I2V和V2V.
不同型号的执行成功率差别很大,在T2V上从0.52到0.94,在I2V上从0.59到0.96,在V2V上从0.69到0.97.

blocks.en:
T2V. Claude Opus 5.5 leads IF and CC with scores of 0.91 and 4.05, respectively, along with AQ and both text–video alignment metrics.
Claude Sonnet 5.5 leads MQ and VE with scores of 3.85 and 3.90, while GPT-6.1 Sol leads VD with 3.88 and TQ, highlighting distinct strengths among leading models across evaluation dimensions.
blocks.zh:
T2V (英语). Claude Opus 5.5分别以0.91和4.05的分数领先IF和CC,以及AQ和两个文本-视频对齐度量.
Claude Sonnet 5.5以3.85和3.90的分数领先MQ和VE,而GPT-6.1 Sol则以3.88和TQ领先VD,凸显了跨评价维度的主要模型之间的显著优势.

blocks.en:
I2V. Claude Opus 5.5 leads both image-fidelity metrics, with PF of 0.89 and SF of 0.66, as well as all five subjective metrics.
GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6 Luna achieve similar image fidelity, with PF scores of 0.83 and 0.82 and SF scores of 0.65 and 0.62, but differ considerably in IF at 0.86 versus 0.70 and MQ at 3.47 versus 2.61, suggesting that faithful keyframe reconstruction does not necessarily ensure strong instruction following or motion quality.
blocks.zh:
I2V (英语). Claude Opus 5.5同时领导图像真实度的度量衡,PF为0.89,SF为0.66,以及所有五个主观度量.
GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6 Luna实现相似的图像忠实,PF分数分别为0.83和0.82,SF分数为0.65和0.62,但在IF中差异很大,分别为0.86对0.70和MQ对3.47对2.61,这表明忠实的键框重建不一定能确保遵循或运动质量的强烈指令.

blocks.en:
V2V. Claude Opus 5.5 leads all three clip-fidelity metrics, with SA of 0.88, AF of 0.79, and MF of 0.44, as well as all five subjective metrics.
Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves comparable clip fidelity, with SA of 0.87, AF of 0.77, and MF of 0.44, but lower IF and CC scores of 0.76 and 3.36, compared with 0.93 and 4.00 for Claude Opus 5.5, highlighting the gap between reference-clip reconstruction and complete-video requirements.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2017-03-25). V2V. Claude Opus 5.5 领导所有三个剪切-真伪度量衡,SA为0.88,AF为0.79,MF为0.44,以及所有五个主观度量.
Claude Sonnet 5.5实现了可比较的剪切忠诚度,SA为0.87,AF为0.77,MF为0.44,但IF和CC的分数分别为0.76和3.36,而Claude Opus 5.5的分数分别为0.93和4.00,凸显了参考-剪切重建与全视频要求之间的差距.

blocks.en: 5 Insights and Discussions
blocks.zh: 5 见解和讨论

blocks.en: 5.1 Quality and Reliability Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.1 质量和可靠性分析

blocks.en:
As shown in Sec. 4.2 , execution success varies substantially across models, motivating a closer examination of how execution failures affect overall quality scores.
We use mean holistic video quality, averaged across four holistic quality metrics, to compare performance over all evaluated tasks and successfully rendered videos.
As shown in Fig. 5 , GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol achieve higher mean holistic quality among successfully rendered videos, with scores of 4.19 and 4.15, respectively, compared with 4.04 for Claude Opus 5.5. However, their higher execution failure rates reduce their full-set means to 3.62 and 3.61, while Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest full-set mean of 3.87.
Higher video quality on successful runs can coexist with lower execution reliability, highlighting the need to consider both when evaluating code-based video generation.
blocks.zh:
如第4.2节所示,各模式的执行成功率差别很大,促使更仔细地审查执行失败如何影响总体质量分数。
我们使用全方位的视频质量,平均分为四个全方位的质量衡量标准,比较所有评估任务的业绩,并成功制作视频。
如图5、GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1所示。 索尔在成功制作的视频中实现更高的平均整体质量,得分分别为4.19分和4.15分,而克劳德·奥普斯5.5的得分则为4.04分. 然而,他们较高的执行失败率将他们的完全设定手段降低到3.62和3.61,而克劳德·奥普斯5.5则实现了最高的全设定平均值3.87.
在成功运行时,较高的视频质量可以与较低的执行可靠性并存,这突出表明在评价基于代码的视频生成时需要考虑两者.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Mean holistic video quality across all evaluated tasks and successfully rendered videos for 15 MLLMs. Bars indicate the difference between the two averages.
blocks.zh: 图5:所有评估任务均具有整体性视频质量,并为15个MLLM成功制作视频。 栏表示两个平均值的差别.

blocks.en: 5.2 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2 失败分析

blocks.en:
We analyze 2,756 error cases to characterize failure patterns across models. As shown in Fig. 6 , failure types vary considerably across models. Compilation errors and missing APIs or packages account for 83.4% of GPT-6 Astra’s failures, while missing APIs and packages alone dominate Qwen3.8-Max at 59.7%. In contrast, runtime exceptions account for 75.0% of Claude Opus 5.5’s failures and over half of those for GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and MiMo-V2.6-Pro. These distinct profiles reveal different sources of failure across models, ranging from code compilation and dependency handling to runtime execution.
Reliably generating lengthy code across interdependent files remains a major challenge, with compilation, dependency, and runtime failures varying across models.
blocks.zh:
我们分析2,756个错误案例,以描述各种模型的故障模式。 如图6所示,不同模型的故障类型差别很大。 编译错误和缺失的API或软件包占GPT-6 Astra失败的83.4%,而缺失API和软件包单独占据了Qune3.8-Max的59.7%. 相比之下,运行时间例外占克劳德·奥普斯5.5失败的75.0%,占GLM-5.3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和MiMo-V2.6-Pro失败的一半以上。 这些不同的剖面显示不同模型的失败源,从代码汇编和依赖处理到运行时间执行不等。
在相互依存的文件中可靠地生成冗长的代码仍然是一项重大挑战,不同模型的汇编、依赖和运行时间的失败各不相同。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Distribution of failure types across nine selected models.
blocks.zh: 图6:9个选定模型的故障类型分布情况。

blocks.en: 5.3 Complexity Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 复杂性分析

blocks.en: To examine how current MLLMs handle increasing task complexity, we analyze performance across construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity levels. As shown in Fig. 7 , performance generally declines with increasing complexity, with SF particularly affected. SF decreases by 14.38% and 12.82% of its score range from L1 to L2 under construction and dynamic animation complexity, respectively. Across most metrics, these two dimensions exhibit steeper declines from L1 to L2 than from L2 to L3, whereas state-dependency complexity shows larger declines from L2 to L3 across all 15 metrics. These contrasting patterns suggest that even moderate construction and dynamic animation complexity can challenge current MLLMs, whereas lower state-dependency complexity is relatively manageable and long-range dependencies remain challenging.
blocks.zh: 为了研究当前MLLM如何处理日益复杂的任务,我们分析整个构造、动态动画和状态依赖性复杂程度的性能。 如图7所示,业绩普遍下降,越来越复杂,特别影响到战略框架。 SF的分数分别下降了14.38%和12.82%,从正在建设的L1到L2和动态动画复杂度不等. 在大多数衡量标准中,这两个维度从L1到L2的下降幅度比从L2到L3的下降幅度更大,而在所有15个衡量标准中,国家依赖性的复杂性则从L2到L3的下降幅度更大。 这些对比性模式表明,即使是适度的构造和动态动画复杂性也会对当前的MLLMS构成挑战,而较低的状态依赖性复杂性则相对可控,远程依赖性仍然具有挑战性.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Performance changes between adjacent complexity levels, using the notation in Fig. 4 . Values are normalized by metric scale, with positive values indicating performance declines.
blocks.zh: 图7 相邻复杂程度之间的性能变化,使用图中的注解. 4. 数值按尺度正常化,正值显示业绩下降。

blocks.en: 5.4 Generation Effort and Cost
blocks.zh: 5.4 生成努力和成本

blocks.en:
We analyze the relationship between generation effort, API cost, and holistic video quality in Fig. 8 . Higher token consumption does not necessarily yield better quality. GLM-5.3-Flash uses 90.0k output tokens per request, compared with 13.9k for GPT-6 Astra, yet achieves a lower quality score of 2.94 versus 3.62. API costs also vary substantially at comparable quality levels. GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra achieve nearly identical quality scores of 3.61 and 3.62, yet GPT-6 Astra incurs approximately 6.1 times the estimated API cost. Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest quality score of 3.87 at a lower estimated cost than GPT-6 Astra.
Greater generation effort and API spending do not necessarily translate into better video quality, revealing substantial differences in efficiency across models.
blocks.zh:
我们分析生成努力、API成本和图8的整体视频质量之间的关系。 较高的象征性消费不一定产生更好的质量。 GLM-5.3-Flash每个请求使用90.0k输出令牌,而GPT-6 Astra则使用13.9k,然而却实现了2.94对3.62的质量分数较低. 相当质量水平的API成本也相差很大. GPT-6.1 Sol和GPT-6 Astra的质量分数几乎相同,分别为3.61分和3.62分,然而GPT-6 Astra却产生大约6.1倍于估计的API成本. 克劳德·奥普斯5.5以比GPT-6 Astra更低的估计费用达到最高质量分数3.87分.
更大的生成努力和API支出并不一定转化为更好的视频质量,揭示了不同模型之间效率的巨大差异.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Output tokens (a) and estimated API cost (b) versus mean holistic video quality for all 15 models, with selected models labeled. Dashed lines indicate the Pareto frontier.
blocks.zh: 图8:所有15种模型的输出符号(a)和估计API成本(b)相对于平均整体视频质量,并标注了选定的模型。 虚线表示帕雷托边疆.

blocks.en: 5.5 MLLM Judge Validation
blocks.zh: 5.5 MLLM 法官验证

blocks.en:
We further validate the Gemini 3.8 Flash judge on 300 outputs from six models of varying capabilities, including GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Kimi K3, Qwen3.8-27B, and MiniMax M3, each evaluated on the same 50 tasks sampled to balance categories and complexity levels.
Each output is evaluated three times to assess scoring stability.
For human validation, three independent raters evaluate a subset of 200 outputs for instruction following and mean holistic video quality.
We compare the three-run judge mean with the three-rater human mean using Pearson’s r r .
As shown in Tab. 5 , Pearson’s r r reaches 0.796 for IF and 0.783 for holistic video quality, while ICC(A,3) reaches 0.983 and 0.970, respectively, indicating strong human alignment and repeat stability.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步验证双子座3.8闪电法官对来自包括GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5、双子座3.8闪电、Kimi K3、Qune3.8-27B和MiniMax M3等6种不同能力模型的300项产出的鉴定,这些模型均对50项任务进行了抽样评估,以平衡类别和复杂程度。
对每项产出进行三次评价,以评估评分稳定性。
为了进行人类验证,三个独立评定员评价200个教学产出的子集,并意味着整体录像质量。
我们用皮尔逊的r.
如塔布所示. 5,皮尔逊的rr在IF中达到0.796,在整体视频质量中达到0.783,而ICC(A,3)则分别达到0.983和0.970,表明人类高度一致和重复稳定.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Gemini 3.8 Flash judge validation. Human Alignment uses Pearson’s r r , and Repeat Stability uses ICC(A,3) on 300 outputs.
blocks.zh: 表5:双子座3.8 Flash法官验证. 人类对齐使用皮尔逊的rr,重复稳定使用ICC(A,3)的300个产出.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for complete code-based video generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V, comprising 2,104 diverse tasks and a comprehensive dual-level evaluation framework. Evaluation of 15 MLLMs reveals persistent challenges in execution reliability, instruction following, reference fidelity, and handling increasing task complexity. We believe that Code2Video-Compass provides valuable insights into the limitations of current MLLMs and serves as a diagnostic testbed for advancing reliable, coherent, and high-quality code-based video generation.
blocks.zh: 我们采用Code2Video-Compass,这是整个T2V、I2V和V2V的完整基于代码的视频生成的通用基准,包括2 104项不同任务和一个全面的双重评价框架。 对15项最低劳动保障标准的评价表明,在执行可靠性、后续指示、参考忠诚度和处理日益复杂的任务方面仍然存在挑战。 我们认为,Code2Video-Compass为了解当前MLLM的局限性提供了宝贵的见解,并成为推进可靠、连贯和高质量的基于代码的视频生成的诊断试验台。
